description: Phase-CACHE — Provider prompt caching + small wins. 5 small stories (~+100/-50 LOC, 1 session) targeting the prompt-and-LLM-call boundary. userStories.title: Server-driven end_turn termination
userStories.description: Parse optional end_turn field from OpenAI-compatible streaming Completed chunk. Propagate to loopResult. Agent loop ORs it into needs_follow_up: if end_turn==false, force another sampling round; otherwise exit even with no tool call. MaxIterations stays as emergency brake, NOT primary signal. Source: Codex core/src/session/turn.rs:2012-2036, :300, :361.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/llm/client.go Response struct exposes optional EndTurn *bool

userStories.title: Tool description ≤200 char audit + single system message consolidation
userStories.description: Two changes: (a) extend description_audit_test.go to assert len(tool.Description()) ≤ 200. Sweep all catalogued tools; shrink descriptions over the cap. (b) Concat all system instructions (base prompt + overlays + memory + skills manifest) into ONE system message at index 0 (picobot pattern). Today some paths emit multi-system-message which fragments the cache prefix and reduces hit rate. Source: picobot #3 + #13. Online §2 Anthropic 'Writing tools for agents'.

userStories.title: Untrusted-content snippet upgrade in base system prompt
